schema.title: OpenVDB grid metadata types
schema.description: The grid class and vector type that affect the interpretation of a grid's voxel values.

VecType.description: The type of a vector determines how transforms are applied to it: Invariant, Covariant, Covariant Normalize, Contravariant Relative, Contravariant Absolute.

MergePolicy.description: Specify how grids should be merged during certain (typically multithreaded) operations.
